eventMessage.title: Event message
eventMessage.summary: A message game masters send to the participants of an event
eventMessage.description: One message from the game masters to the participants of one event: its subject and plain-text body ({event} and {date} are filled in per mail), the audience it went to, and how many people it reached. Larpinq mails each recipient on their own through the Nextcloud mailer on a queued job. Read and written by game masters only.

event.title: Event
event.description: The event whose participants receive this message.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: The subject line of the mail; {event} and {date} are filled in per recipient.

body.title: Message
body.description: The plain-text body of the mail; {event} and {date} are filled in per recipient.

audience.title: Audience
audience.description: Which participants of the event receive the message.

statuses.title: Registration status
statuses.description: Only registrations in one of these states; empty means every state.

checkedIn.title: Checked in only
checkedIn.description: Only participants who have checked in at the event.

paymentOpen.title: Payment open only
paymentOpen.description: Only participants whose payment is still open.

ticketRoles.title: Ticket role
ticketRoles.description: Only participants with a ticket of one of these roles; empty means every role.

state.title: Status
state.description: Where the message is: a draft, queued for sending, sent, or failed.

recipientCount.title: Recipients
recipientCount.description: How many participants matched the audience when the message was sent.

sentCount.title: Sent
sentCount.description: How many mails the mailer accepted.

failedCount.title: Failed
failedCount.description: How many mails could not be sent.

noAddressCount.title: No address
noAddressCount.description: How many matching participants had no e-mail address and were skipped.

sentBy.title: Sent by
sentBy.description: The user id of the game master who sent the message.

sentAt.title: Sent at
sentAt.description: When the last mail of the message was handed to the mailer.
